deskyard type: type text into the focused window

Usage: deskyard [-d NAME] type TEXT...

Types text into the focused window, as keystrokes. Several arguments are
joined with spaces. Click the field first; use key for Return, Tab or
shortcuts.

Arguments:
  TEXT       string...   required  text to type

Prints: nothing

Examples:
  deskyard type 'hello world'

Where: inside a desktop it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen remote (-d NAME)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
